title: Cloud Engineer / IT Infrastructure & Systems Administrator
description:
**Position Overview**

We are looking for a hands-on **IT Infrastructure & Systems Administrator** to manage and support our day-to-day technology infrastructure across end-user systems, hardware, networking, cloud infrastructure, servers, websites, Microsoft 365/Entra, AWS, databases, security, and business communication systems.

This is a **hands-on technical role**, not limited to helpdesk support. The ideal candidate should be comfortable troubleshooting issues independently, making configuration changes, coordinating with vendors, monitoring systems, and escalating complex issues when required.

The person will be responsible for keeping our IT infrastructure reliable, secure, and operational while providing timely support to employees and internal teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. End-User Hardware & IT Support**

· Diagnose and troubleshoot laptops and desktops, including systems that fail to power on or have hardware-related issues.

· Troubleshoot and replace keyboards, mice, headsets, monitors, RAM, SSDs, and other peripherals.

· Install and troubleshoot printers, drivers, connectivity, and common printer issues.

· Troubleshoot monitor/display issues, including no signal, flickering, and resolution problems.

· Support CCTV cameras and DVR/NVR systems, including connectivity and basic fault diagnosis.

· Manage biometric and face-access systems, including user enrollment and troubleshooting.

· Support UPS systems, including battery checks/replacements and basic server-room power troubleshooting.

· Set up systems for new employees, including unboxing, OS/software configuration, imaging, asset assignment, and user readiness.

· Maintain accurate IT asset inventory and manage hardware handover, return, replacement, and tracking.

**2. Windows, Microsoft 365 & User Administration**

· Install, reinstall, configure, and troubleshoot Windows operating systems and drivers.

· Install and configure Microsoft Office, Teams, Outlook, and other standard business applications.

· Troubleshoot Windows updates, patch failures, application errors, and system performance issues.

· Install and manage antivirus/security software and troubleshoot endpoint security issues.

· Create, modify, disable, and manage user accounts and access.

· Manage email account creation, deletion, permissions, and mailing-list membership.

· Troubleshoot Outlook synchronization, mailbox capacity, archiving, and profile issues.

· Manage OneDrive and SharePoint permissions, sharing, and access.

· Install business applications and manage license activation.

· Troubleshoot browser, plugin, profile, and application-related issues.

· Support **Microsoft Entra ID application management**, permissions, and access configuration.

**3. Network & Connectivity**

· Troubleshoot office internet connectivity and coordinate with ISPs when required.

· Troubleshoot Wi-Fi, LAN, network ports, and individual user connectivity issues.

· Configure and troubleshoot VPN access.

· Assist with firewall rule requests, port access, and website allowlisting.

· Troubleshoot IP addressing, DHCP, DNS, and internal network issues.

· Configure and troubleshoot wireless access points.

· Analyze slow internet, bandwidth utilization, latency, and connectivity problems.

· Monitor network alerts and perform initial troubleshooting of link failures.

· Manage and troubleshoot SIP/PRI telephone connectivity and coordinate with telecom vendors.

· Manage SMS gateway and DLT-related configuration, registration, and delivery issues.

· Support **RingCentral** administration and configuration.

· Support **Twilio** account and configuration management.

· Develop and maintain automation scripts for network and systems administration tasks.

**4. AWS Cloud Infrastructure**

· Manage day-to-day AWS infrastructure and operational requests.

· Start, stop, and manage EC2 instances based on approved requirements.

· Provision new EC2 instances and configure servers.

· Manage Security Groups, ports, and access requirements.

· Create and manage S3 buckets, access policies, and object-level access.

· Create and manage IAM users, roles, and permissions.

· Resize EC2 instances and increase CPU/RAM capacity when required.

· Expand EBS volumes and manage associated storage requirements.

· Manage snapshots, AMIs, backups, and restoration activities.

· Support Auto Scaling Groups and Load Balancers.

· Configure and troubleshoot CloudWatch alarms and monitoring.

· Support access and configuration for SQS and Lambda.

· Monitor AWS usage and costs and identify opportunities for optimization.

· Review AWS billing alerts and investigate unexpected cost increases.

· Follow appropriate security and access-control practices when making AWS changes.

**5. Website, Server & Application Infrastructure**

· Host and configure websites and applications on IIS, Nginx, and Apache environments.

· Configure websites across QA, UAT, and Production environments.

· Manage SSL certificate purchases, renewals, installation, and configuration.

· Manage domain renewals and DNS record changes.

· Perform application releases and deployments to UAT and Production environments.

· Support deployment rollback when required.

· Execute approved database scripts and support database backup/refresh activities.

· Troubleshoot website/server issues, including site outages and HTTP 500 errors.

· Perform server disk-space cleanup and log management.

· Restart services and troubleshoot failed services.

· Monitor server uptime, system health, and application alerts.

· Review server and application logs to identify issues.

· Perform Linux and Windows server patching and basic hardening.

· Manage environment configuration, including web.config and related application settings.

· Manage FTP and approved server/application credentials.

· Support environment replication and configuration changes.

· Manage Git/GitHub repository permissions and access.

· Support database and website access controls and audit requirements.

**6. Security & Access Management**

· Maintain appropriate access controls across systems, applications, servers, AWS, Microsoft 365, and network infrastructure.

· Provision and deprovision employee access based on approved requests.

· Review user and application permissions periodically.

· Support endpoint security, antivirus, patching, and system hardening.

· Maintain appropriate administrative access controls and credentials.

· Investigate and escalate security-related alerts or incidents.

· Maintain documentation of critical infrastructure configurations and access procedures.

**7. Vendor & Infrastructure Coordination**

· Coordinate with ISPs, telecom providers, hardware vendors, software vendors, hosting providers, and other technology partners.

· Open and manage vendor support tickets.

· Follow up on unresolved infrastructure issues and ensure timely resolution.

· Validate vendor-provided solutions and confirm successful implementation.

· Maintain records of vendor contacts, contracts, licenses, and support information.

**8. Monitoring, Documentation & IT Operations**

· Monitor critical systems, servers, network infrastructure, AWS resources, and application availability.

· Respond to infrastructure alerts and troubleshoot issues proactively.

· Maintain IT infrastructure documentation, including network diagrams, server information, configurations, and procedures.

· Maintain accurate hardware/software inventory.

· Document recurring issues and develop standard troubleshooting procedures.

· Identify opportunities to automate repetitive IT administration tasks.

· Maintain appropriate change records for production infrastructure changes.

· Support business continuity, backup, and recovery procedures.

**Required Technical Skills**

The ideal candidate should have practical experience with several of the following:

· Windows Desktop & Windows Server

· Linux

· Microsoft 365 / Entra ID / Active Directory

· DNS / DHCP / TCP/IP

· LAN / WAN / Wi-Fi / VPN

· Firewall administration

· AWS EC2 / S3 / IAM / EBS / CloudWatch / Load Balancer / Auto Scaling

· SQS / Lambda

· IIS / Nginx / Apache

· SSL / DNS / Domain management

· Git / GitHub

· Basic database administration and SQL

· Endpoint security / Antivirus

· CCTV / DVR / NVR / Biometric/access-control systems

· Cloud VOIP / SMS Platform such as RingCentral / Twilio

· Microsoft Office / Teams / Outlook / OneDrive / SharePoint

**Candidate Profile**

We are looking for someone who is:

· **Hands-on and technically strong**, rather than purely managerial.

· Comfortable troubleshooting unfamiliar issues and finding solutions independently.

· Able to work across hardware, software, network, cloud, and server environments.

· Strong at root-cause analysis and problem solving.

· Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with multiple priorities.

· Able to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical users.

· Comfortable coordinating with external vendors and service providers.

· Disciplined about documentation, access control, security, and change management.

· Willing to take ownership of an issue from initial diagnosis through resolution.

· Able to distinguish between issues they can resolve directly and issues requiring escalation to specialized vendors or engineering teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

· Bachelor's degree or equivalent technical education in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

· 3–7+ years of relevant hands-on IT infrastructure/system administration experience.

· AWS certification is a plus.

· Microsoft certification is a plus.

· Experience supporting distributed offices or multiple locations is a plus.

· Experience with IT automation/scripting is a plus

· Experience supporting production websites, applications, and cloud infrastructure is strongly preferred.

Pay: ₹400,000.00 - ₹600,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Cloud and DevSecOps Engineer
description:
**The Role: Cloud \& DevSecOps Engineer**

Day to day, that means designing and running our infrastructure across Google Cloud Platform and AWS, owning our GitLab CI/CD pipelines, and implementing the security controls that protect PHI and financial data.

This role has a deliberate growth path. You will start as the hands\-on engineer who builds and secures the platform. Over your first year, you will work alongside the team lead and an external compliance specialist. During that time you will take on increasing ownership of our HIPAA program and SOC 2 Type II attestation, moving from implementing controls to designing and leading them. The goal is that you become our security and compliance lead. We will fund necessary training to get you there.

If you want your infrastructure and security decisions to actually matter, and you want a path from senior engineer to program owner, this is that role.

**What You'll Do**

***Cloud Architecture: GCP and AWS***

* Design, deploy, and operate our SaaS infrastructure across GCP and AWS using HIPAA\-aligned reference architectures.
* Make sure every workload touching PHI runs only on HIPAA\-eligible services. Business Associate Agreements must be signed for each cloud account and project before any PHI lands.
* Implement network segmentation and VPC design, encryption at rest and in transit, KMS key management, and least\-privilege IAM across both clouds.
* Build everything as infrastructure\-as\-code with Terraform. Environments should be reproducible, reviewable, and auditable.

***DevOps and GitLab CI/CD***

* Own and improve our GitLab CI/CD pipelines end to end: build, test, scan, deploy.
* Integrate security scanning into the pipeline (SAST, dependency and SCA scanning, container and IaC scanning) without turning delivery into a crawl.
* Manage secrets, artifacts, and release processes securely. Keep PHI out of logs, caches, and lower environments.
* Support the development team. Good pipelines make other engineers faster, not slower.

***Security Engineering***

* Implement and maintain technical safeguards: phishing\-resistant MFA, centralized audit logging, monitoring and alerting, vulnerability management, and incident response.
* Enforce bastion or VDI\-only production access with no local download of PHI, backed by DLP and egress controls.
* Keep production access minimal and regularly reviewed. Use de\-identified or synthetic data in development and test environments.
* Respond to security events and lead post\-incident reviews.

***Compliance: HIPAA, SOC 2 Type II, Plaid***

*Starting out, you implement and evidence. Over time, you design and lead.*

* Implement the technical controls behind our HIPAA Security Rule safeguards and SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria, then take ownership of the program as you grow into the role.
* Operate our compliance automation platform (Vanta, Drata, or Secureframe): keep evidence collection running, monitor for control drift, close gaps.
* Own the security side of our Plaid integration. That means TLS 1\.2\+ and mTLS where required, encrypted secrets, least\-privilege access to financial data, and monitoring for unauthorized access. You will also support Plaid's production access review and security questionnaire. Handling consumer financial data carries GLBA and FTC Safeguards Rule obligations, and you will help us meet them.
* Support penetration tests and audits: help scope them, coordinate with the testers and auditor, and drive remediation.
* Over time, you will lead the HIPAA risk analysis, own control design, select and manage the external auditor, and carry us through the SOC 2 Type II observation period.

**What You Need**

* 3\+ years in cloud engineering, DevOps, or DevSecOps.
* Hands\-on production experience on both GCP and AWS. Not one cloud plus a certification in the other: real production work in both.
* Strong GitLab CI/CD experience, or equivalent CI/CD depth and the ability to move to GitLab quickly.
* Terraform and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Practical security engineering: IAM and least privilege, encryption, secrets management, network security, logging and monitoring.
* Working exposure to HIPAA or SOC 2 in practice. You should be able to explain what a control is and how you'd evidence it.
* The judgment to handle PHI responsibly and work inside strict access controls.
* Clear written and spoken English. You will document data flows, controls, and decisions that auditors and customers read.

**Nice to Have**

* Prior work at a healthcare, fintech, or other regulated SaaS company handling sensitive data.
* Hands\-on experience with a compliance automation platform (Vanta, Drata, Secureframe, Sprinto).
* Experience integrating a financial data provider such as Plaid, and awareness of GLBA / FTC Safeguards Rule obligations.
* Any of these certifications: AWS Solutions Architect Professional, AWS Security Specialty, Google Professional Cloud Architect, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, CISSP, CCSP, CISM, HITRUST CCSFP.
* Experience working directly with external auditors or remediating penetration test findings.

**How To Apply:** Share your CV on careers@dronatechlabs.com

Pay: ₹80,000\.00 \- ₹100,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

title: Senior Manager IT
description:
We are seeking a **PLM****Solution****Architect** to lead the design and delivery of complex **PTC****Windchill** ecosystems. If you have experience with **PLM,****ERP,****CAD****integrations,****cloud****migration,****microservices,****Java,****and****enterprise****architecture**, this is your opportunity to work on cutting\-edge engineering and manufacturing transformation programs.  

Your role  

Key responsibilities in your new role

  

* Define and own the Windchill solution architecture, roadmap, standards, and implementation strategy aligned with business and enterprise goals.
* Gather and analyze business requirements, translating them into scalable and effective PLM solutions.
* Design and configure Windchill solutions covering product data, CAD management, workflows, lifecycles, roles, teams, and access controls.
* Provide technical leadership for Windchill customizations, code reviews, governance, and best practices.
* Architect integrations between Windchill and enterprise applications such as ERP, ALM, document management systems, and portals.
* Lead cloud migration, platform upgrades, data migration, and legacy system modernization initiatives.
* Drive digital engineering experiences through dashboards, portals, and connected solutions.
* Establish and support DevOps, CI/CD, automation, release management, and deployment practices.
* Mentor developers, architects, and project teams while ensuring delivery quality and technical excellence.
* Collaborate with stakeholders, business leaders, and IT teams to drive architecture decisions and solution adoption.
* Support pre\-sales activities, including solution design, effort estimation, RFP responses, and proof\-of\-concept demonstrations.
* Maintain architecture documentation, interface specifications, deployment guides, and knowledge\-sharing materials.
* Promote quality assurance, continuous improvement, training, and operational best practices.

  

Your profile  

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Manufacturing, or a related field.
* Extensive experience in enterprise PLM architecture and large\-scale PTC Windchill implementations.
* Strong expertise in Windchill configuration, customization, workflows, lifecycles, object models, access control, teams, groups, and product/document management.
* Hands\-on experience with Java/J2EE, REST APIs, JavaScript/Node.js, Python, scripting, databases, and reporting technologies.
* Proven track record of designing and implementing integrations between PLM, ERP, ALM, CAD, IoT, document management systems, portals, and middleware platforms.
* Exposure to connected product and digital engineering solutions is preferred.
* Good understanding of cloud migration, microservices, platform upgrades, de\-customization, data migration, and legacy system modernization.
* Experience with Agile delivery, DevOps, CI/CD, source control, release management, automated testing, and environment governance.
* Ability to create and present solution architectures, interface designs, data flows, technical roadmaps, and proof of concepts (PoCs).
* Strong technical leadership with experience in team mentoring, solution reviews, issue resolution, and delivery ownership.
* Customer\-facing consulting experience, including stakeholder workshops, product demonstrations, pre\-sales support, RFP responses, and technical presentations.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, communication, stakeholder management, and interpersonal skills.
* Certifications such as PMP, TOGAF, PTC, Cloud, or Agile are an added advantage.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across global teams, locations, and time zones, including support during critical releases, migrations, and stabilization activities.
